sources.title: Multi — one task, the right AI workflow
sources.snippet: Multi puts 300+ models from every major lab to work across four workflows, so you deploy the best AI for each task instead of forcing one to do it all. Using the right model for the right project is the advantage most people leave on the table.

sources.title: Abdu07/multitask-model · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The model uses a ResNet-50 backbone with two heads: one for multi-class object recognition and another for binary classification (AI-generated vs. Real). It was trained on a subset of the Hemg/AI-Generated-vs-Real-Images-Datasets and leverages YOLO for improved pseudo-labeling across the entire dataset.
